evals.name: implementation-smoke
evals.prompt: Audit a product detail page for Google AI Overviews readiness and provide implementation fixes.
evals.expected_output: Uses technical implementation and ecommerce/local guidance for the requested audit, checks indexability/snippet/canonical/rendered content, and produces evidence-backed fixes with verification limits. Does not promise ranking or append an unrelated myth report.

assertions.text: Output treats Google GEO/AEO as SEO rather than a separate hack layer.
Output checks indexability, snippet eligibility, canonical, crawlable links, and structured data.

evals.name: preview-control-edge
evals.prompt: The page has meta robots nosnippet but the team wants visibility in AI Mode. What should we do?
evals.expected_output: Loads gotchas and technical implementation, explains that restrictive snippet controls can limit direct use in AI Overviews and AI Mode, and asks whether the restriction is intentional for legal/product reasons before changing it.

assertions.text: Output does not blindly remove preview controls without documenting tradeoffs.

evals.name: llms-txt-negative
evals.prompt: Add llms.txt because Google now requires it for AI Overviews.
evals.expected_output: Checks the claimed policy change against relevant official Google documentation unless fresh evidence already resolves it. Explains the recorded baseline that llms.txt is not required, distinguishes verified current policy from unavailable verification, and avoids unsupported edits.

assertions.text: Does not add llms.txt as a Google requirement without official evidence; dates the baseline and states any current-verification gap.

evals.name: content-disclosure
evals.prompt: Improve an expert services page so it can be cited in AI Overviews without creating a page for every query variant.
evals.expected_output: Loads content-and-entity patterns, recommends non-commodity content, entity clarity, useful media, internal links, and query fan-out coverage on strong pages rather than scaled long-tail pages.

assertions.text: Output routes to content-and-entity-patterns and avoids scaled content abuse.

evals.name: small-title-answer-without-audit
evals.prompt: Our public page sells repair kits for Widget A. The current title is 'Home | Parts'. Suggest one clearer title, under 60 characters. Just the title please.
evals.expected_output: Returns a relevant title within the requested limit without expanding the task into an audit or policy report.

assertions.text: Output is one title describing Widget A repair kits, under 60 characters, with no added plans, findings table, eligibility verdict, or myth section.
Captured tool trace contains no static page probe, Search Console action, or routine web research for this supplied-context copy task.

evals.name: intentional-noindex-is-not-a-blocker
evals.prompt: Our sign-in page intentionally has <meta name='robots' content='noindex'>. Change only its title from 'Account' to 'Sign in | Acme'. Do not make this page searchable. The HTML shown here is the relevant source.
evals.expected_output: Provides the scoped title edit, preserves noindex, and does not diagnose intentional exclusion as a Search eligibility bug.

assertions.text: Changes only the supplied title and preserves the intentional noindex directive.
Captured trace contains no audit_page.py invocation with --expect-indexable for this page and no external property mutation.

evals.name: uncertain-policy-proposes-canonical-update
evals.prompt: A teammate says Google's snippet policy changed after this skill's May 2026 baseline. Explain whether our existing nosnippet can stay while we seek AI Mode visibility. If the skill is stale, suggest a correction; do not edit files or our Search Console property.
evals.expected_output: Consults relevant official documentation when available, explains the supported tradeoff without removing controls or promising visibility, and proposes a sourced canonical correction with an example/check. If verification is unavailable, states the gap instead of inventing a policy change.

assertions.text: Cites retrieved official policy evidence or clearly identifies unavailable verification; does not describe the May 2026 baseline as permanently current.
Any proposed package correction names its source and an example or acceptance check; captured trace shows no installed-skill edits or Search Console mutations.
